items.title: 資金急找避風港！全球貨幣市場基金吸金1538億美元 美股基金轉失血
items.title_en: Funds Scramble for Safe Havens! Global Money‑Market Funds Pull in $153.81 Billion, US Equity Funds Turn Red
paras: 全球債市賣壓加劇，美債殖利率攀高與油價居高不下，加深投資人對通膨的疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。根據LSEG Lipper數據，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月6日當周以來最多；美國股票基金則終止連兩周吸金，遭撤資51.1億美元。
標普500指數本周稍早觸及7,844.52點歷史新高，隨後回落。通膨疑慮引發債市拋售，美國10年期公債殖利率攀抵5.3645%，創2002年4月以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，也促使投資人在股市上漲之際獲利了結。
歐洲債務問題同樣牽動市場。法國預算赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重超過5%，加上明年總統大選恐加劇政治分歧，推升其10年期公債殖利率至4.994%，創24年新高。
全球股票基金當周僅淨流入5.6億美元，為近三周最少。歐洲與亞洲股票基金分別吸金61.9億及61.6億美元，美國則出現9月16日當周以來首次淨流出。其中，美國大型、中型及小型股基金分別失血140.8億、10.3億及8.34億美元。
不過，資金並未全面撤離美股。美國產業型基金仍吸金56.8億美元，以科技類股的45.3億美元居首，公用事業與工業類股也分別吸金11.8億及10.4億美元。
債券基金也持續獲資金青睞。全球債券基金淨流入260.3億美元，創7月8日當周以來最多；其中，美國債券基金吸金197.8億美元，創單周紀錄。美國短中期政府債券與公債基金吸金67.6億美元，為六個月最多，短中期投資等級債券基金另吸金50.4億美元。
美國貨幣市場基金則淨流入684.9億美元，扭轉前一周淨流出436億美元的情況。此外，全球黃金及其他貴金屬基金連續第四周吸金，當周流入14.1億美元。新興市場債券基金吸金14.8億美元，股票基金則連續第五周失血，淨流出7.52億美元。
paras_en: Global bond‑market selling pressure intensified, with U.S. Treasury yields climbing and oil prices staying high, deepening investors' inflation concerns and prompting a shift toward safe‑haven assets. According to LSEG Lipper data, in the week to October 7 the net inflow into global money‑market funds was $153.81 billion, the largest since the week of May 6; U.S. equity funds, meanwhile, ended a two‑week inflow streak with a net outflow of $5.11 billion.

The S&P 500 touched a record high of 7,844.52 points earlier this week before pulling back. Inflation worries sparked a bond‑market sell‑off, pushing the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.3645%—a peak not seen since April 2002—dampening market sentiment and prompting investors to take profits as equities rose.

Europe's debt issues also weighed on markets. France’s budget deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, and the upcoming presidential election next year could heighten political divisions, lifting its 10‑year sovereign yield to 4.994%, a 24‑year high.

Global equity funds recorded a net inflow of only $560 million for the week, the lowest in nearly three weeks. European and Asian equity funds attracted $6.19 billion and $6.16 billion respectively, while the U.S. saw its first weekly net outflow since the week of September 16. U.S. large‑cap, mid‑cap and small‑cap equity funds lost $14.08 billion, $1.03 billion and $834 million respectively.

Nevertheless, money has not fled U.S. equities entirely. U.S. sector funds still drew $5.68 billion, led by technology funds with $4.53 billion, while utilities and industrials attracted $1.18 billion and $1.04 billion respectively.

Bond funds continued to enjoy inflows. Global bond funds saw a net inflow of $26.03 billion, the highest since the week of July 8; U.S. bond funds alone attracted $19.78 billion, a single‑week record. U.S. short‑ and intermediate‑term government and sovereign bond funds pulled in $6.76 billion, the most in six months, and short‑ and intermediate‑term investment‑grade bond funds added another $5.04 billion.

U.S. money‑market funds recorded a net inflow of $68.49 billion, reversing the previous week’s outflow of $43.6 billion. Meanwhile, global gold and other precious‑metal funds logged a fourth consecutive week of inflows, bringing in $1.41 billion. Emerging‑market bond funds attracted $1.48 billion, while equity funds suffered a fifth straight week of outflows, netting a $752 million withdrawal.

items.title: 美債獲轉機？法國公債遭拋售意外支撐美債、美10年期殖利率逼近24年高點
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Find a Lifeline? French Bond Sell‑off Unexpectedly Supports U.S. Debt, 10‑Year Yield Near 24‑Year High
paras: 法國公債市場因財政與政治風險升高而遭遇賣壓，意外為美國公債帶來支撐。瑞穗銀行（Mizuho）亞太區宏觀策略主管Vishnu Varathan指出，投資人拋售法國公債之際，轉而尋求美國公債與德國公債等相對安全的資產。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Varathan週四（8日）在報告中表示，市場最初的反應似乎是轉向避險，資金流入德國公債與美國公債，而非出現全面性的金融風險蔓延。
不過，這不代表美債殖利率已開始下跌。他指出，美國公債殖利率隔夜仍小幅走高，只是避險資金流入限制了升幅。
週四稍早，美國10年期公債殖利率升至5.3%，法國10年期公債殖利率則為4.9%，雙雙接近2002年以來的最高水準。
隨著通膨壓力、油價上漲與政府債務攀升，法國已成為近期全球債券拋售潮的新一處風險焦點，投資人對法國公共財政狀況的疑慮日益加深，進一步推升公債殖利率。
與此同時，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮也為債市帶來額外壓力。市場預期，AI帶來的生產力提升將推動經濟成長，並使利率在較長時間內維持高檔。
此外，企業為興建資料中心及其他AI基礎設施而大舉舉債，也與政府發行的公債競逐投資資金，進一步推高債券殖利率。
Varathan在報告中指出，儘管整體市場壓力持續升高，法國公債市場的動盪尚未引發大規模的風險蔓延，還不至於迫使歐洲央行（ECB）介入。
不過，若市場情勢進一步惡化，歐洲央行可能放慢縮減公債持有規模的步伐，以穩定市場。
Varathan也預期，隨著投資人要求持有長天期債務獲得更高的風險補償，各國政府的借貸成本將持續處於高檔。
至於美國公債，法國債市動盪帶來的支撐可能只是暫時的。美國本身同樣面臨沉重的債務負擔與地緣政治風險，未來也可能遭遇類似的市場考驗。
Varathan警告，債券市場的「義警」不會停止行動，只會選擇不同的目標與時機發動攻勢。
paras_en: French sovereign bond markets faced selling pressure as fiscal and political risks rose, unexpectedly providing support for U.S. Treasuries. Vishnu Varathan, head of macro strategy for Asia‑Pacific at Mizuho, said investors dumping French bonds turned to relatively safe assets such as U.S. and German government debt.

According to Business Insider, Varathan said in a Thursday (the 8th) report that the market’s initial reaction appeared to be a flight to safety, with capital flowing into German and U.S. sovereign bonds rather than a broad‑based spread of financial risk.
However, that does not mean U.S. Treasury yields have started to fall. He noted that Treasury yields were still inching higher overnight, but inflows into safe‑haven assets capped the upside.
Earlier on Thursday, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 5.3%, while the French 10‑year yield was 4.9%, both nearing their highest levels since 2002.

With inflation pressure, rising oil prices and mounting government debt, France has become a new focal point of the recent global bond sell‑off, as investors’ doubts about French public finances deepen, pushing yields higher.

At the same time, the AI investment boom is adding extra strain to the bond market. The market expects AI‑driven productivity gains to boost economic growth and keep rates elevated for an extended period.
Moreover, corporations are borrowing heavily to build data centers and other AI infrastructure, competing with government‑issued bonds for investor capital and further lifting bond yields.

Varathan noted in the report that despite rising overall market pressure, the turmoil in the French sovereign market has not yet sparked a large‑scale risk contagion, nor does it compel the European Central Bank to intervene.
Nevertheless, if market conditions worsen further, the ECB may slow the pace of reducing its sovereign‑bond holdings to stabilize the market.
Varathan also expects that as investors demand higher risk premiums for holding long‑dated debt, borrowing costs for governments worldwide will remain elevated.

As for U.S. Treasuries, the support from French market turbulence may be only temporary. The United States also faces a heavy debt load and geopolitical risks, and could face similar market tests in the future.
Varathan warned that the bond market’s “vigilante” will not cease its actions; it will simply pick different targets and timing for its attacks.

items.title: 馬斯克終究會推手機？Munster：Starlink裝置將對蘋果、三星帶來「更大問題」
items.title_en: Will Musk Eventually Launch a Phone? Munster: Starlink Devices Will Pose "Bigger Problem" for Apple and Samsung
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)已同意收購全美低頻段頻譜，而投資人Gene Munster認為，即使執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)曾表示不想製造手機，SpaceX最終仍會推出自有手機。
Munster周四(8日)在X平台發文表示，「馬斯克說他不想製造手機，但我仍認為SpaceX終究會推出。」
這位Deepwater Asset Management管理合夥人補充指出，「採用垂直整合設計、搭配Starlink行動網路的手機，可能提供電信業者無法匹敵的功能，以及更便宜的服務。」
Munster表示，這項發展對三星電子(Samsung Electronics)的衝擊將大於蘋果(AAPL-US)，因為蘋果的「裝置與服務整合關係更難被打破」。
根據Statcounter，截至9月，蘋果在全球行動裝置市場的市占率為30.8%，三星則為23.52%。
SpaceX周四同意收購Grain Management持有的全美800 MHz頻譜資產組合。SpaceX表示，這項交易將「為Starlink在美國成為主要行動電信業者鋪路」。
SpaceX指出，低頻段頻譜將有助於Starlink行動訊號穿透牆壁及其他障礙物，提供「在室內、室外、行動網路訊號盲區，以及介於兩者之間所有地點的可靠服務」。
馬斯克形容這項交易是「非常重大的進展」。

馬斯克對製造手機的態度

馬斯克2024年在賓州一場市民座談會上表示，「製造手機這個想法讓我想死。但如果我們不得不做手機，我們就會做。但我們會盡可能避免走到製造手機這一步。」
今年稍早，馬斯克表示，未來推出手機「並非完全不可能」，但那將會是「與目前手機截然不同的裝置」，專門針對AI神經網路運算進行設計，以每瓦功耗實現最高效能。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that SpaceX (SPCX-US) has agreed to acquire the nationwide low‑frequency spectrum, and investor Gene Munster believes that even though CEO Elon Musk has said he does not want to make phones, SpaceX will ultimately launch its own handset.
Munster posted on X on Thursday (the 8th) that “Musk says he doesn’t want to make phones, but I still think SpaceX will eventually launch one.”

The Deepwater Asset Management managing partner added that a vertically integrated phone built with Starlink mobile connectivity could offer capabilities telecom operators can’t match, along with cheaper service.
Munster said the impact of this development on Samsung Electronics will be greater than on Apple (AAPL-US), because Apple’s device‑and‑service integration is harder to disrupt.
According to Statcounter, as of September Apple’s share of the global mobile device market was 30.8%, while Samsung’s was 23.52%.

SpaceX on Thursday agreed to purchase the nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio held by Grain Management. SpaceX said the deal will “pave the way for Starlink to become a major mobile carrier in the United States.”

SpaceX noted that low‑frequency spectrum will help Starlink’s mobile signal penetrate walls and other obstacles, delivering reliable service “indoors, outdoors, in mobile dead zones, and everywhere in between.”
Musk described the transaction as “a very significant development.”

Musk’s attitude toward making phones: In a 2024 town‑hall meeting in Pennsylvania, Musk said, “The idea of making a phone makes me want to die. But if we have to make a phone, we will. We’ll try to avoid getting to that point as much as possible.”

Earlier this year, Musk said launching a phone “is not completely impossible,” but it would be “a device fundamentally different from current phones,” designed specifically for AI neural‑network computing and delivering maximum performance per watt.

items.title: 亞弘電前9月營收轉爲正成長 下半年轉強並在台增設新產線
items.title_en: Yahong Electronics' September Revenue Turns Positive, Gains Strength in H2 and Adds New Production Line in Taiwan
paras: 以專業代工電子專業音訊及保健器材開發服務爲主軸的亞弘電 (6201-TW)，今(2026)年訂單能見度不弱，下半年接單出貨轉強，帶動9月營收衝高到4.35億元，創68個月來新高，月增25.56%，年增59.54%，前 9 月營收26.17億元，與去年同期比較轉爲正成長，年增1.13%；亞弘電在台南也增設一條生產線，以因應需求的成長。
亞弘電第三季營收突破11億元，達11.09億元，季增36.9%，年增25.36%。
亞弘電下半年以來訂單明確，並有向第四季延伸的走勢，營收的成長主要因新機種驗貨、出貨順暢，同時，9月營收出現跳升，除8月出貨的遞延因素挹注之外，還有歐洲船期延長，部分客戶有提前出貨趨勢；同時，唱盤客戶訂單也有所增加
此外，亞弘電本季營運也有旺季效應加持。9、10月原本就是電子音訊產品的出貨旺季，主要受惠於客戶為因應萬聖節、感恩節及耶誕節等年末消費旺季，提前備貨、拉貨，帶動相關產品出貨需求。
亞弘電主管指出，因應客戶後續有部分新機種產品體積較大之需求，公司也已擴充好新產線設備準備生產。
亞弘電2026年上半年營收15.08億元，毛利率23.47%，稅後純益1.35億元，每股純益達1.52元。
paras_en: Yahong Electronics (6201‑TW), which focuses on professional contract manufacturing of electronic audio and health‑care devices, saw strong order visibility in 2026. In the second half of the year, orders and shipments picked up, pushing September revenue up to NT$4.35 billion – a 68‑month high – up 25.56% month‑over‑month and 59.54% year‑over‑year. Revenue for the first nine months reached NT$26.17 billion, turning positive versus the same period last year with a 1.13% annual increase. The company also added a new production line in Tainan to meet growing demand.
In the third quarter, Yahong Electronics’ revenue broke NT$11 billion, reaching NT$11.09 billion, up 36.9% sequentially and 25.36% year‑over‑year.

Orders have been clear since the second half of the year and are extending into the fourth quarter. Revenue growth was driven by new‑model inspections and smooth shipments. September’s revenue jump was aided not only by delayed shipments from August but also by extended European vessel schedules, prompting some customers to ship earlier; orders from disc‑player customers also increased.

In addition, the quarter benefited from seasonal demand. September and October are traditionally peak months for electronic audio product shipments, as customers stock up ahead of the Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas shopping season, boosting demand for related products.
A company executive noted that, because some upcoming new‑model products have larger volumes, the firm has already expanded its new production‑line equipment to prepare for manufacturing them.
For the first half of 2026, Yahong Electronics reported revenue of NT$15.08 billion, a gross margin of 23.47%, net profit after tax of NT$1.35 billion, and earnings per share of NT$1.52.

items.title: AI資料中心擴建潮推升光通訊！Lumentum砸3.5億美元擴產仍追不上訂單
items.title_en: AI Data Center Expansion Fuels Demand for Optical Communications! Lumentum Spends $350 Million on Capacity Expansion Yet Still Can’t Keep Up with Orders
paras: 受惠於人工智慧（AI）資料中心需求快速成長，光學元件製造商Lumentum(LITE-US) 正面臨產能追不上訂單的壓力。執行長Michael Hurlston表示，公司產品訂單已全面售罄至2029年初。
Hurlston週五（9日）接受《彭博》採訪時指出，部分產品明年的需求約有70%無法獲得滿足，另一些產品直到2028年仍有約30%的需求缺口。相較半年前他預估產能將於2028年售罄，如今訂單滿載的時間已提前近一年。
Hurlston表示：「我們的產能已全部售罄，而且看不到盡頭。」
市場對Lumentum的營收成長也抱持高度期待。分析師平均預估，公司今年銷售額將較去年成長逾一倍。
為因應訂單激增，Lumentum過去兩年已將位於東京都會區的關鍵工廠產能提升至原本的12倍，並計畫對該廠及鄰近設施合計投入至少3.5億美元。公司位於英國Caswell的工廠也已完成擴產。
然而，光學元件製造涉及長期的產能建置，難以迅速跟上需求變化。Hurlston指出，Lumentum這類企業建立新的生產能力通常需要3至5年，因此超大規模雲端運算業者已承諾提供資金支持，協助分攤擴產所需的資本支出。
除了增加既有產能，Lumentum也考慮透過併購擴大產品布局。Hurlston表示，公司希望在未來一年左右，進一步增加現有產品線尚未涵蓋的能力。
Lumentum主要供應磷化銦（Indium Phosphide）元件，這類材料是高速雲端運算與資料傳輸的重要技術基礎。
今年稍早，輝達(NVDA-US) 分別向Lumentum及競爭對手Coherent(COHR-US) 投資20億美元，顯示AI晶片大廠正加強布局光學互連供應鏈。
矽光子技術被視為下一代資料中心互連的重要發展方向，透過光訊號取代銅纜傳輸資料，不僅能支援 AI 硬體提升資料傳輸速度，也有助於降低散熱需求與能源消耗。
Lumentum部分相關技術來自2018年收購Oclaro。Oclaro承接了日立的光學研究技術，其位於日本相模原的工廠如今已是全球先進的磷化銦元件生產基地之一。
paras_en: Benefiting from the rapid growth in AI data center demand, optical component maker Lumentum (LITE‑US) is facing pressure as capacity can’t keep up with orders. CEO Michael Hurlston said the company’s product orders are fully booked through early 2029.

Hurlston told Bloomberg on Friday the 9th that about 70% of next year’s demand for certain products cannot be met, and another roughly 30% gap will persist for some products until 2028. Compared with his estimate six months ago that capacity would be sold out by 2028, the fully‑booked horizon has now moved up by almost a year.
Hurlston said, “Our capacity is completely sold out, and we see no end in sight.”
The market has high expectations for Lumentum’s revenue growth. Analysts on average forecast the company’s sales this year to more than double last year’s figure.

To cope with the order surge, Lumentum has already increased capacity at its key plant in the Tokyo metropolitan area to 12 times its original level over the past two years and plans to invest at least $350 million in that facility and nearby sites. Its plant in Caswell, UK, has also completed an expansion.

However, building optical component capacity is a long‑term effort that cannot quickly match demand swings. Hurlston noted that companies like Lumentum typically need three to five years to establish new production capability, so the largest cloud providers have pledged funding to help share the capital expense of the expansion.

In addition to expanding existing capacity, Lumentum is also considering acquisitions to broaden its product portfolio. Hurlston said the company aims to add capabilities not currently covered by its product lines within roughly the next year.
Lumentum primarily supplies indium phosphide components, a material that underpins high‑speed cloud computing and data transmission technologies.
Earlier this year, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) invested $2 billion each in Lumentum and rival Coherent (COHR‑US), showing that AI chip giants are strengthening their optical interconnect supply chains.

Silicon photonics is seen as the next‑generation data‑center interconnect technology, using light signals instead of copper cables to transmit data. This not only supports AI hardware by boosting data‑transfer speeds but also helps reduce cooling requirements and energy consumption.

Some of Lumentum’s relevant technologies stem from its 2018 acquisition of Oclaro. Oclaro had taken over Hitachi’s optical research technology, and its plant in Sagamihara, Japan, is now one of the world’s most advanced indium phosphide component manufacturing sites.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉巧新營收創高 切入半導體設備供應鏈 股價挑戰前高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Qiao Xin Posts Record Revenue, Moves Into Semiconductor Equipment Supply Chain, Stock Tests Prior Highs
paras: 全球汽車輪圈領導廠商巧新(1563-TW)公布9月合併營收8.16億元，月增48.45%、年增39.69%，創單月新高紀錄，本周股價也再度見到8字頭，逼近9月7日現金減資25%前價位；市場已開始關注巧新切入半導體新領域的進程，巧新回應，第四季後以半導體設備關鍵零組件為非車用事業的重要發展方向。
巧新指出，切入半導體前段設備(CVD/PVD、蝕刻)腔體的相關零組件領域，目前已完成與國際客戶合作產品驗證，並進入試量產階段，預期將堆疊新一波營運成長動能。
巧新第三季合併營收達20.16億元，季增1.83%，年增18.48%，前三季合併營收58.68億元，年增9.99%， 9月營收強勁主要受惠於歐美超跑、豪華車品牌客戶需求持續回溫，隨著第三季歐美車廠例行性暑休告一段落，主要客戶陸續恢復正常生產及拉貨節奏，帶動客製化鍛造鋁合金輪圈出貨動能提升。
除既有車用本業持續穩健成長外，投資人開始關注巧新切入半導體市場的時程。
巧新指出，正開拓非車用事業第二成長曲線，面對全球半導體產業持續擴大先進製程投資，以及設備供應鏈對高品質、低碳材料和在地化供應的需求，切入半導體前段設備(CVD/PVD、蝕刻)腔體相關零組件領域，完成與國際客戶合作進行產品驗證，並進入試量產。
進入第四季後，巧新以半導體設備關鍵零組件為非車用事業的重要發展方向，加速推動再生鋁相關應用產品驗證及量產導入，拓展國際半導體供應鏈合作機會。
而巧新屏東新熔煉廠正依建廠計畫推進工程建置、設備導入和後續試車驗證，預計於2027年第三季逐步量產。
paras_en: Qiao Xin (1563‑TW), a global leader in automotive wheels, reported September consolidated revenue of NT$8.16 billion, up 48.45% month‑over‑month and 39.69% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month record. This week its share price again rose into the 8‑yuan range, approaching the pre‑capital‑reduction level of September 7. The market is now watching the company’s progress in entering the semiconductor arena, and Qiao Xin responded that after the fourth quarter it will make key semiconductor‑equipment components a major growth direction outside its automotive business.

Qiao Xin noted that its entry into front‑end semiconductor equipment (CVD/PVD, etching) chamber components has already completed product verification with international customers and entered a trial‑production stage, which is expected to generate a new wave of operational growth momentum.

In the third quarter, Qiao Xin’s consolidated revenue reached NT$20.16 billion, up 1.83% sequentially and 18.48% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$58.68 billion, a 9.99% annual increase. The strong September performance was mainly driven by renewed demand from European and American super‑car and luxury‑vehicle customers. As the routine summer shutdowns at European and American automakers ended, major clients resumed normal production and shipping schedules, boosting shipments of customized forged‑aluminum alloy wheels.
Beyond its steady growth in the automotive core business, investors are beginning to focus on the timeline for Qiao Xin’s entry into the semiconductor market.

Qiao Xin said it is developing a second growth curve outside the automotive sector. Facing the global semiconductor industry’s continued expansion of advanced‑process investments and the supply‑chain demand for high‑quality, low‑carbon materials and localized sourcing, the company is targeting front‑end semiconductor equipment (CVD/PVD, etching) chamber components. It has completed product verification with international customers and moved into trial production.

After entering the fourth quarter, Qiao Xin will prioritize key semiconductor‑equipment components as a major development direction for its non‑automotive business, accelerating validation and mass‑production of recycled‑aluminum‑based applications and expanding cooperation opportunities within the international semiconductor supply chain.

Qiao Xin’s new smelting plant in Pingtung is progressing according to its construction plan, with engineering, equipment installation, and subsequent test‑run verification underway, and is slated to begin phased mass production in the third quarter of 2027.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉融程電9月營收衝高+明年展望樂觀 股價站回季線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Rongcheng Electronics September Revenue Soars + Optimistic Outlook for Next Year, Stock Returns to Quarterly Line
paras: 工業電腦廠融程電(3416-TW)9月營收衝上5.34億元，創單月新高，月增31.8%、年增95.9%，加上明年展望樂觀，激勵周四股價跳空大漲，一度逼近漲停，收盤仍漲逾7%，來到182元站回季線、半年線之上。
融程電前9月累計營收35.36億元，年增34.2%，同步改寫歷史新高，主要受惠國防軍工、半導體及邊緣AI市場終端需求強勁接單暢旺，明年整體營運將再創新高。
融程電表示，因應不同市場需求調整出貨及生產配置，邊緣AI、國防軍工應用成長預估至少5成，推出國防軍工無人機與機器人應用的強固型邊緣AI平台，搶攻國防軍工、船舶海事電腦、智慧製造、智慧醫療、物流到智慧城市等應用擴展全球產業鏈。
展望後市，持續強化在美國、韓國、日本生產組裝行銷，Key Account 佈局，與加快歐洲的整合，並與主要供應商建立長期策略合作關係，確保關鍵料件供應穩定，持續進一步深化國防軍工、半導體及邊緣運算市場。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Rongcheng Electronics (3416-TW) posted September revenue of NT$5.34 billion, a monthly record, up 31.8% month‑on‑month and 95.9% year‑on‑year. With an optimistic outlook for next year, the stock jumped on Thursday, briefly approaching the daily limit up, and closed up more than 7% at NT$182, back above the quarterly and half‑year moving averages.

Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$35.36 billion, a 34.2% year‑over‑year increase, setting a new historical high. The growth was driven by strong demand and orders from defense & military, semiconductor and edge‑AI markets, and the company expects overall operations to hit another record next year.

Rongcheng Electronics said it is adjusting shipments and production allocations to meet different market needs; it forecasts at least a 50% growth for edge‑AI and defense‑military applications, and is launching a rugged edge‑AI platform for defense drones and robotics, targeting defense‑military, ship‑board maritime computers, smart manufacturing, smart healthcare, logistics and smart city applications to expand its global supply chain.

Looking ahead, the firm will continue to strengthen production, assembly and marketing in the United States, South Korea and Japan, expand its key‑account layout, accelerate integration in Europe, and establish long‑term strategic partnerships with major suppliers to ensure stable supply of critical components, further deepening its presence in defense‑military, semiconductor and edge‑computing markets.

items.title: 南僑成T+T+A三掛牌集團 整合資源強攻東協食品、烘焙商機
items.title_en: Nanqiao T+T+A Triple-Listed Group Integrates Resources to Aggressively Target ASEAN Food and Bakery Opportunities
paras: 南僑(1702-TW)集團包括上海南僑食品(605339-SH)、皇家可口(7791-TW)爲少數T+T+A的兩岸三掛牌集團，南僑董事長陳正文今(9)日指出，東南亞的東協市場實為潛力極大的市場，上海南僑食品已在泰國設立NFB子公司，同時，皇家可口也有在當地的開發、拓銷計畫。
在集團資源的整合下，南僑持續在東協此一成長性高的市場布局，陳正文指出，對此一市場的整合行銷相當一致。
南僑在泰國投資生產事業已經30年，在泰國投資第四條及第五條生產線都已全部正式量產，營收從2019年以來維持6%以上的複合成長率，而到2025年達42.5億泰銖、年成長58%。泰國南僑營收有81%來自米製品，預計2026年要把市場再擴大，朝更創新及更功能化產品邁進，陸續開發與推出新產品。
皇家可口在台灣的急凍熟麵第三條生產線已正式投產，董事長周明芬表示，未來將在集團資源整合與挹注下，進一步拓展市場版圖，除深耕台灣市場外，也將泰國及其他國際市場列為開發重點。此外，即食產品的市場拓展，以及與通路業者建立合作關係，也將是公司未來重要的營運策略。
上海南僑食品主力產品包括油脂、冷凍麵糰及預製烘焙等產品，在泰國成立子公司已經達2年，並設立烘焙展示中心，包括進一步開發泰國極度國際化的餐飲及餐飲市場，成效已逐漸顯現。
南僑董事長陳正文指出，烘焙事業已在印尼、馬來西亞設立子公司，在泰國烘焙展示中心設立後，印尼、馬來西亞預計也將循此一模式進一步進行東協市場的深度開發。
paras_en: Nanqiao (1702-TW) Group, which includes Shanghai Nanqiao Food (605339-SH) and Royal Kuo (7791-TW), is one of the few cross‑strait T+T+A triple‑listed groups. Chairman Chen Zhengwen said today (the 9th) that the ASEAN market in Southeast Asia holds huge potential. Shanghai Nanqiao Food has already set up an NFB subsidiary in Thailand, and Royal Kuo also has development and sales plans in the region.

With the integration of group resources, Nanqiao continues to lay out its strategy in the high‑growth ASEAN market. Chen Zhengwen noted that the integrated marketing approach for this market is highly consistent.

Nanqiao has been investing in production in Thailand for 30 years. The fourth and fifth production lines have both entered full‑scale mass production, and revenue has maintained a compound annual growth rate of over 6% since 2019. Revenue is projected to reach 4.25 billion baht by 2025, a 58% year‑on‑year increase. About 81% of Thai Nanqiao’s revenue comes from rice‑based products, and the company aims to further expand the market in 2026, moving toward more innovative and functional products while continuously developing and launching new items.

Royal Kuo’s third frozen cooked‑noodle production line in Taiwan has officially started operation. Chairman Zhou Mingfen said that, leveraging the group’s integrated resources and capital, the company will further expand its market footprint. In addition to deepening its presence in Taiwan, Thailand and other international markets are also key development targets. Moreover, expanding the ready‑to‑eat product line and building partnerships with channel partners will be important operational strategies going forward.

Shanghai Nanqiao Food’s core products include oils, frozen dough and ready‑made bakery items. Its Thai subsidiary, established two years ago, has set up a bakery demonstration centre and is further developing Thailand’s highly internationalised foodservice market, with results beginning to show.

Chairman Chen Zhengwen said the bakery business has already established subsidiaries in Indonesia and Malaysia. After the bakery demonstration centre was set up in Thailand, the subsidiaries in Indonesia and Malaysia are expected to follow the same model to deepen development across the ASEAN market.

items.title: 亞弘電前9月營收轉爲正成長 下半年轉強並在台增設新產線
items.title_en: Yahong Electronics' September Revenue Turns Positive, Gains Strength in H2 and Adds New Production Line in Taiwan
paras: 以專業代工電子專業音訊及保健器材開發服務爲主軸的亞弘電 (6201-TW)，今(2026)年訂單能見度不弱，下半年接單出貨轉強，帶動9月營收衝高到4.35億元，創68個月來新高，月增25.56%，年增59.54%，前 9 月營收26.17億元，與去年同期比較轉爲正成長，年增1.13%；亞弘電在台南也增設一條生產線，以因應需求的成長。
亞弘電第三季營收突破11億元，達11.09億元，季增36.9%，年增25.36%。
亞弘電下半年以來訂單明確，並有向第四季延伸的走勢，營收的成長主要因新機種驗貨、出貨順暢，同時，9月營收出現跳升，除8月出貨的遞延因素挹注之外，還有歐洲船期延長，部分客戶有提前出貨趨勢；同時，唱盤客戶訂單也有所增加
此外，亞弘電本季營運也有旺季效應加持。9、10月原本就是電子音訊產品的出貨旺季，主要受惠於客戶為因應萬聖節、感恩節及耶誕節等年末消費旺季，提前備貨、拉貨，帶動相關產品出貨需求。
亞弘電主管指出，因應客戶後續有部分新機種產品體積較大之需求，公司也已擴充好新產線設備準備生產。
亞弘電2026年上半年營收15.08億元，毛利率23.47%，稅後純益1.35億元，每股純益達1.52元。
paras_en: Yahong Electronics (6201‑TW), which focuses on professional contract manufacturing of electronic audio and health‑care devices, saw strong order visibility in 2026. In the second half of the year, orders and shipments picked up, pushing September revenue up to NT$4.35 billion – a 68‑month high – up 25.56% month‑over‑month and 59.54% year‑over‑year. Revenue for the first nine months reached NT$26.17 billion, turning positive versus the same period last year with a 1.13% annual increase. The company also added a new production line in Tainan to meet growing demand.
In the third quarter, Yahong Electronics’ revenue broke NT$11 billion, reaching NT$11.09 billion, up 36.9% sequentially and 25.36% year‑over‑year.

Orders have been clear since the second half of the year and are extending into the fourth quarter. Revenue growth was driven by new‑model inspections and smooth shipments. September’s revenue jump was aided not only by delayed shipments from August but also by extended European vessel schedules, prompting some customers to ship earlier; orders from disc‑player customers also increased.

In addition, the quarter benefited from seasonal demand. September and October are traditionally peak months for electronic audio product shipments, as customers stock up ahead of the Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas shopping season, boosting demand for related products.
A company executive noted that, because some upcoming new‑model products have larger volumes, the firm has already expanded its new production‑line equipment to prepare for manufacturing them.
For the first half of 2026, Yahong Electronics reported revenue of NT$15.08 billion, a gross margin of 23.47%, net profit after tax of NT$1.35 billion, and earnings per share of NT$1.52.

在集團資源的整合下，南僑持續在東協此一成長性高的市場布局，陳正文指出，對此一市場的整合行銷相當一致。
南僑在泰國投資生產事業已經30年，在泰國投資第四條及第五條生產線都已全部正式量產，營收從2019年以來維持6%以上的複合成長率，而到2025年達42.5億泰銖、年成長58%。泰國南僑營收有81%來自米製品，預計2026年要把市場再擴大，朝更創新及更功能化產品邁進，陸續開發與推出新產品。
皇家可口在台灣的急凍熟麵第三條生產線已正式投產，董事長周明芬表示，未來將在集團資源整合與挹注下，進一步拓展市場版圖，除深耕台灣市場外，也將泰國及其他國際市場列為開發重點。此外，即食產品的市場拓展，以及與通路業者建立合作關係，也將是公司未來重要的營運策略。
上海南僑食品主力產品包括油脂、冷凍麵糰及預製烘焙等產品，在泰國成立子公司已經達2年，並設立烘焙展示中心，包括進一步開發泰國極度國際化的餐飲及餐飲市場，成效已逐漸顯現。
南僑董事長陳正文指出，烘焙事業已在印尼、馬來西亞設立子公司，在泰國烘焙展示中心設立後，印尼、馬來西亞預計也將循此一模式進一步進行東協市場的深度開發。
paras_en: Nanqiao (1702-TW) Group, which includes Shanghai Nanqiao Food (605339-SH) and Royal Kuo (7791-TW), is one of the few cross‑strait T+T+A triple‑listed groups. Chairman Chen Zhengwen said today (the 9th) that the ASEAN market in Southeast Asia holds huge potential. Shanghai Nanqiao Food has already set up an NFB subsidiary in Thailand, and Royal Kuo also has development and sales plans in the region.

With the integration of group resources, Nanqiao continues to lay out its strategy in the high‑growth ASEAN market. Chen Zhengwen noted that the integrated marketing approach for this market is highly consistent.

Nanqiao has been investing in production in Thailand for 30 years. The fourth and fifth production lines have both entered full‑scale mass production, and revenue has maintained a compound annual growth rate of over 6% since 2019. Revenue is projected to reach 4.25 billion baht by 2025, a 58% year‑on‑year increase. About 81% of Thai Nanqiao’s revenue comes from rice‑based products, and the company aims to further expand the market in 2026, moving toward more innovative and functional products while continuously developing and launching new items.

Royal Kuo’s third frozen cooked‑noodle production line in Taiwan has officially started operation. Chairman Zhou Mingfen said that, leveraging the group’s integrated resources and capital, the company will further expand its market footprint. In addition to deepening its presence in Taiwan, Thailand and other international markets are also key development targets. Moreover, expanding the ready‑to‑eat product line and building partnerships with channel partners will be important operational strategies going forward.

Shanghai Nanqiao Food’s core products include oils, frozen dough and ready‑made bakery items. Its Thai subsidiary, established two years ago, has set up a bakery demonstration centre and is further developing Thailand’s highly internationalised foodservice market, with results beginning to show.

Chairman Chen Zhengwen said the bakery business has already established subsidiaries in Indonesia and Malaysia. After the bakery demonstration centre was set up in Thailand, the subsidiaries in Indonesia and Malaysia are expected to follow the same model to deepen development across the ASEAN market.

items.title: 高明鐵9月、Q3營收創新高 單季營收6.51億元超越去年全年
items.title_en: Gaoming Iron September, Q3 Revenue Sets New High; Quarterly Revenue 6.51 Billion Beats Full-Year 2025
paras: 受惠 AI 資料中心建置加速、高速光通訊升級，以及高精密耦合自動化設備需求持續升溫，由鏡頭組裝轉型為光通訊耦光工站的高明鐵 (4573-TW)，今(9)日公布最新營收，9月再創新高，第三季營收6.51億元同創新高，單季營收更是超越去 (2025) 年全年營收。
高明鐵2026年9月營收2.3億元，月增4.7%，年增3.36倍，第三季單季營收6.51億元，超越2025年全年6.03億元，季增44.31%、年增3.24倍，累計1-9月營收13.54億元，年增2.07倍。
高明鐵2026年上半年財報營收7.03億元，毛利率39.35%，年增16.71個百分點，稅後純益1.21億元，較去年轉盈，超越歷年全年獲利，每股純益達2.9元。法人預估高明鐵下半年營收及獲利大幅優於上半年，也等於是 2026 年業績將較去年倍數成長。
高明鐵通過全球前 10 大光通訊品牌廠認證，取得 800G 及 1.6T 耦光對位產品訂單，同時切入 CPO 封裝測試及 FAU＋MLA 精密組裝市場的龐大商機。
已加入矽光子聯盟的高明鐵，2026 年以來營運規模持續增強，在 AI 高速傳輸與光通訊設備領域的接單與出貨動能持續升溫。同時，高明鐵 4000 張現增股，以每股 325 元溢價發行，已完成募集 13 億元資金。
高明鐵董事長陳志鑫指出，本次增資順利完成，代表資本市場對高明鐵轉型矽光子設備事業的肯定。高明鐵將以精密運動控制數十年累積的技術底蘊，結合 AI 對位演算法，成為 CPO 產業鏈中不可或缺的光耦合解決方案供應商。
paras_en: Benefiting from accelerated AI data‑center construction, upgrades to high‑speed optical communications, and rising demand for high‑precision coupled automation equipment, Gaoming Iron (4573‑TW), which has shifted from lens assembly to optical‑communication coupling workstations, announced today that September’s revenue hit a new peak and Q3 revenue reached NT$6.51 billion, also a record, with the single‑quarter revenue surpassing the entire 2025 full‑year figure.

Gaoming Iron posted NT$2.3 billion in September 2026, up 4.7% month‑over‑month and 3.36‑fold year‑over‑year. Q3 single‑quarter revenue was NT$6.51 billion, exceeding the full‑year 2025 revenue of NT$6.03 billion, a 44.31% quarterly increase and 3.24‑fold annual increase. Cumulative revenue for January‑September reached NT$13.54 billion, up 2.07‑fold year‑over‑year.

In the first half of 2026, Gaoming Iron reported revenue of NT$7.03 billion with a gross margin of 39.35%, an increase of 16.71 percentage points year‑over‑year, and a post‑tax profit of NT$1.21 billion, turning profitable compared with the prior year and surpassing any full‑year profit in its history. Earnings per share reached NT$2.9. Analysts forecast that the second‑half revenue and profit will far outpace the first half, implying that 2026 results will grow multiple times over the previous year.

Gaoming Iron obtained certification from the world’s top‑10 optical‑communication brand manufacturers, securing orders for 800 G and 1.6 T optical‑coupling alignment products, and simultaneously entered the large‑scale opportunities in CPO packaging testing and FAU + MLA precision assembly markets.

Having joined the Silicon Photonics Alliance, Gaoming Iron’s operating scale has continuously expanded since 2026, with order and shipment momentum in AI high‑speed transmission and optical‑communication equipment remaining strong. In addition, the company issued 4,000 new shares at a premium of NT$325 per share, raising NT$1.3 billion.

Chairman Chen Zhixin said the successful capital increase reflects the market’s confidence in Gaoming Iron’s transition to silicon‑photonics equipment. The company will leverage decades of precision motion‑control technology combined with AI alignment algorithms to become an indispensable optical‑coupling solution provider in the CPO industry chain.
